blocks.text: “Pinoy Big Brother Collab 3.0” has discontinued all its livestreams amid concerns over cyberbullying, online harassment, and the alleged spread of malicious narratives involving its housemates. Hosts Bianca Gonzalez and Gabbi Garcia announced the decision during the show’s Saturday, November 21 episode, reading a joint statement from ABS-CBN and GMA Network. The decision to stop all livestreams took effect on the same day. In their statement, the networks explained that livestreaming was initially introduced to allow viewers to get to know the housemates better.
